title: Law to set privacy and disclosure rules for chatbots
summary: This bill would require companies offering chatbots to secure user data, let users access their own chat logs and disclose clearly that they are talking to a chatbot, not a human. It would bar using personal data for training without consent, prohibit targeted ads and profiling from chat logs, ban selling chat logs without consent and limit data retention to 10 years. Violators would face civil penalties up to $25,000 per violation and could be sued directly by users; the law would take effect 180 days after passage.
